# PreIPOKart

> PreIPOKart is an Indian marketplace where people buy and sell shares in private companies before those companies list on a stock exchange.

PreIPOKart is not a recognised stock exchange, listed-market broker, or guaranteed counterparty. Prices on the home page and company pages are last-traded or indicative, not NSE or BSE quotes. An investor browses companies, places a buy or sell request at a stated price and quantity, and funds are held until the deal settles.

If a page does not exist, or a company, blog post, or policy cannot be found, the site sends the visitor to the companies list at https://preipokart.in/explore.

A longer guide for language models is at https://preipokart.in/llms-full.txt.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://preipokart.in/): What PreIPOKart is, how a request is placed, and a sample of companies.
- [Companies](https://preipokart.in/explore): Searchable list of private companies on the book. This is also the fallback for missing pages.
- [Company page](https://preipokart.in/explore): Open a company from the list. Each company lives at /stocks/{id}. A missing company returns to /explore.
- [IPOs](https://preipokart.in/ipos): Upcoming, open, and recent public issues, separate from the unlisted book.
- [Blog](https://preipokart.in/blog): Market notes. Each post lives at /blog/{slug}. A missing post returns to /explore.
- [FAQ](https://preipokart.in/faq): Common questions about buying, selling, KYC, and fees.
- [Help](https://preipokart.in/help): Short answers for using the product.
- [Contact](https://preipokart.in/contact): Bengaluru office and a message form. Email hello@preipokart.in.
- [Careers](https://preipokart.in/careers): Open roles. Applications go to careers@preipokart.in.
- [Terms of use](https://preipokart.in/legal/terms): Platform rules.
- [Privacy policy](https://preipokart.in/legal/privacy): What personal information is collected and why.
- [Sign up](https://preipokart.in/signup): Create an account with name, email, and password.
- [Log in](https://preipokart.in/login): Sign in to an existing account.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://preipokart.in/sitemap.xml): Public URLs for crawlers.
- [Full LLM guide](https://preipokart.in/llms-full.txt): Product summary, page map, and what not to crawl.
- [API reference](https://api.preipokart.in/v1): JSON API used by the site. Public reads include companies, IPOs, blog, FAQ, and legal pages.

## Do not crawl

Signed-in screens are not public content: /dashboard, /portfolio, /orders, /place-order, /profile, /notifications, /kyc, and /biometric.
